title: Carnot Cycle
description: An ideal reversible cycle composed of two isothermal heat-exchange stages and two adiabatic stages, setting the maximum heat-engine efficiency between two reservoirs.

relations.note: Reversible isothermal stages provide heat exchange at each reservoir temperature.
Reversible adiabatic stages connect the two isotherms without heat transfer.
The reversible cycle supplies the maximum efficiency for engines using the same two reservoirs.
